role: Internal frozen renderer resource for the single Billfish 3D preview plugin
preservation: Original lib files, including embedded third-party notices and decoder resources, are retained byte-for-byte. No Core or licensing code was changed. This record does not create a new license grant.
registration: This resource directory is not an installed plugin and has no plugin manifest, main entry or viewer.html. The single plugin id remains billfish.animation-browser.
coverage: The original declared 23 3D formats plus HDR/EXR viewer-only declarations are retained. Representative rendering tests do not establish that every format has been individually exercised.
trustBoundary: Core executes as trusted CJS in the context-isolated preload world. The page keeps Node disabled and a strict script CSP; public viewport methods accept no arbitrary source path. This is not an OS or Node filesystem sandbox. Original relative model resources remain supported.
